task.title: Actioning the fraudulent renewal — Client is not requesting benefits

step.cmd: In SPS, for each payment issued to a third party, determine if the payment must be cancelled :

ul.li: If yes, note the payment reference number, the amount (gross benefits and net amount), w/c, BT, CT and the date the payment was processed. This information is required on the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) . Go to step 2. Note

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the Integrity registration number.
Detection: This field is prefilled according to the investigation type in NIIS.
Message: Select 27 - An overpayment resulted due to an incorrect calculation .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the Integrity registration number.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 54 - Third party fraud .
Remarks line 1: Type “Cancel fraudulent renewal w/c [XXXX]. Unknown third party.”

Remark lines 2–4: For all payments to be removed including cycling claimant’s reports, type “Remove w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX]. Total amount $[XXXX]. Adjust tax file or T4E. No OP for client.” If payments have been returned or cheques were never redeemed, type “Also cancel returned payments or uncashed cheques, as appropriate, for w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX].” For each payment, type “w/c [XXXX] / [T071-2 for current year or T071-8 for the previous year] / reason F / CT [XX] / gross benefits [XXXX] / federal tax [XX] / provincial tax [XX] (if necessary) / net amount [XXXX] / PRN [XXXXXXXXXXXX].” Type “Client is not requesting benefits.” If an MA was imposed to stop payments, type “Rescind MA [XX].” If as a result of the recalculation due to a deleted fraudulent ROE, a disqualification must be imposed from the same BPC as the fraudulent renewal application, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX].” If a disentitlement must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
Remarks line 5: Enter your name and telephone number.

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD on the client’s application and not on the fraudulent application as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity file number] — fraudulent renewal.”

Details: Type “The investigator confirmed the client’s address and banking information on: [DD-MM-YYYY]. The client’s address is: [client’s address]. The client’s banking information is: [client’s banking information].” If Integrity identified fraudulent ROEs, type “Integrity confirmed that ROE [serial number] is fraudulent.” Document the decision and rationale according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Create a ROD on the fraudulent renewal application as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity file number] — renewal submitted by a third party.”

Details: Enter the following information:
Relevant facts: Type “An EI renewal application was filed by a third party on [DD-MM-YYYY] using the client’s identity.”
Decision/Justification: Type “This renewal application was not filed by the client and must not be included in an access to information request.”

step.cmd: To delete the fraudulent application, create a REM WI as follows:

ul.li: Due date: Enter the next business day.
Destination — SCC: Enter the SCC as shown in FTS.

End user: Select Specific user:
Enter the name of the team leader or the designated person and select Find user .

step.cmd: In NIIS, on the Decision tab of the IC70 Report of Investigation screen, close the case as follows:

ul.li:
Disentitlement: Select No .
Reason: Select Other and type “Fraudulent renewal. Third-party OP amount is $[XX].”
Overpayment: Do not check either box.

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the CR Integrity ERB-EI Transition WI and all other related WIs.
